name: Glasses X API specification
description: Remote API for the Tobii Glasses X application. Use it to control recordings, check device status, stream live view, track upload progress, and download local recordings.

signals.name: glasses.is_connected
signals.description: Emits the current connection state of the glasses.

signals.name: live_viewer.ice_candidate.discovered
signals.description: Emits an ICE candidate generated by the app for the active live view session.

type.name: sdp_m_line_index
type.description: The index of the related m-line in the SDP.

type.name: candidate
type.description: The ICE candidate string generated by the app.

signals.name: live_viewer.is_streaming
signals.description: Emits the current live view streaming state.

signals.name: uploader.progress.changed
signals.description: Emits an update when a recording upload changes state.

type.name: recording_id
type.description: The ID of the local recording.

type.name: hub_recording_id
type.description: The backend recording ID for this upload. Empty until available.

type.name: updated_at
type.description: The UTC timestamp, in ISO 8601 format, of the latest upload state change.

properties.name: glasses.serial_number
properties.description: Returns the serial number of the connected glasses. Returns an empty string if no glasses are connected.

properties.name: recorder.current.id
properties.description: Returns the ID of the current recording. Returns an empty string if no recording is in progress.

properties.name: recorder.current.name
properties.description: Returns the name of the current recording. Returns an empty string if no recording is in progress.

properties.name: recorder.current.duration_seconds
properties.description: Returns the duration of the current recording, in seconds. Returns 0 if no recording is in progress.

properties.name: glasses.audio.is_enabled
properties.description: Reports whether audio is enabled for live view and recording.

actions.name: recorder.start

args.name: name
args.description: Optional recording name. If omitted or empty, the app uses a timestamp-based name.

args.name: project_id
args.description: Optional project ID used when uploading the recording so the backend can place it in the correct project within the selected workspace.

returns.description: The ID of the started recording.

actions.description: Starts a recording by using the same flow as the app UI. If provided, `project_id` is stored and used for upload routing in the active workspace.

actions.name: recorder.stop

type.name: recording_id
type.description: The ID of the saved recording.

type.name: gaze_percentage
type.description: The percentage of gaze samples that were valid in the saved recording.

type.name: gaze_samples
type.description: Total number of gaze samples collected in the recording.

type.name: valid_gaze_samples
type.description: The number of valid gaze samples in the saved recording.

returns.description: Summary metadata for the saved recording. This matches the completion information shown in the app.

actions.description: Stops the current recording by using the same flow as the app UI and returns summary metadata for the saved recording.

actions.name: recordings.list

returns.description: The folder names of the saved recordings, sorted by name.

actions.description: Lists the recordings that the app saved in local mode. Fails in connected mode.

actions.name: recordings.files.list

args.name: recording
args.description: A folder name from `recordings.list`, or the recording ID that `recorder.stop` returns.

returns.description: One HTTP GET path for each file in the recording, relative to the Public API address.

actions.description: Lists the download paths of a recording that the app saved in local mode. Fails in connected mode, and until the app finishes saving the recording.

actions.name: live_viewer.session.create

args.name: ice_servers
args.description: Optional list of ICE servers for the live view session.

args.name: streams
args.description: Optional list of streams to send: `video`, `video_gaze_overlay`, `audio`, `gaze2d`, `gaze3d` and `timesync`. Leave it out to get `video_gaze_overlay` and `audio`. `video_gaze_overlay` replaces `video` if both are listed. `timesync` needs a video stream. While the in-app preview is open, the video always has the gaze circle drawn in.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the session is created or an active session is reused. Returns `false` if session creation fails. Fails with `invalid_args` for an invalid `streams` list, and with `action_failed` if the active remote session uses a different list.

actions.description: Creates a WebRTC live view session. The API supports one session at a time. If a session is already active, this action reuses it.

actions.name: live_viewer.offer.create

returns.description: SDP offer generated by the app, or null if offer creation fails.

actions.description: Creates an SDP offer for the active live view session. The offer always has a video and an audio track. A track sends nothing unless its stream is chosen, but the video track also sends while the live view is open in the app. It also has the data channels chosen with `streams` in `live_viewer.session.create`.

actions.name: live_viewer.ice_candidate.add

args.name: index
args.description: SDP media-line index associated with this ICE candidate.

args.name: candidate
args.description: ICE candidate gathered by the client.

actions.description: Adds a client ICE candidate to the active live view session.

actions.name: live_viewer.session.start

args.name: answer
args.description: The SDP answer created by the client.

returns.description: Returns true on success. Returns false on failure.

actions.description: Starts live view streaming by applying the provided SDP answer to the active session.

actions.name: live_viewer.session.delete
actions.description: Deletes the active live view session, if one exists.
